title: Stage 5: Phase E + F - per-persona reports, cross-persona rollup, vetting layer
description:
Aggregate flow-result.json files from a run dir into:
- PersonaReport per persona (findings grouped by severity + flow)
- RunReport across all personas (cross-persona patterns; same bug seen by multiple personas = high signal)

Vetting layer:
- Each finding must carry artifacts + a replay strategy
- Re-run the replay; if it doesn't re-hit, drop the finding (or flag subjective if non-deterministic)
- Axe findings: re-navigate at the step URL, re-run axe, assert same rule id present
- Persona-judge findings: re-run flow steps to that point, re-judge; if judge disagrees flag subjective
- Console/network errors: noise tier - flag subjective by default

Output: markdown report at .gauntlet/runs/<ts>/REPORT.md and JSON sidecar.

New:
- src/report/schema.ts (Finding, PersonaReport, RunReport zod)
- src/report/generator.ts (flow-result.json -> findings)
- src/report/rollup.ts (cross-persona aggregation)
- src/report/vetter.ts (replay verification)
- src/report/render-markdown.ts
- 'gauntlet report' CLI command; auto-run at end of 'gauntlet run'
close_reason: Stage 5 / Phases E+F shipped. New src/report/ module: schema (Finding/PersonaReport/RunReport with vetting status), generator (flow-result.json -> Findings with per-flow dedup across steps), rollup (cross-persona patterns from shared signatures), vetter (group findings by URL, share one Playwright browser, navigate-once+axe-once per URL, map back to all findings), render-markdown (severity-sorted markdown with [VERIFIED]/[regressed]/[subjective] badges and artifact paths), build (top-level orchestrator + findLatestRunDir). 'gauntlet report' CLI; 'gauntlet run' auto-builds report w/ vetting at the end; --no-report / --no-vet escape hatches. Live verified: 6 raw axe failures collapsed to 3 deduped findings; vetter re-navigated to iana.org once, re-ran axe, all 3 verified - color-contrast, html-has-lang, link-in-text-block.

title: Stage 4: Phase D - flow execution loop per persona
description:
Read curated flow(s) for each persona, drive Playwright through the steps using act/observe/extract primitives (tn8.2), evaluate success_criteria after each step via the AI, capture every step. Terminate when: (a) all steps succeed, (b) give_up_criteria hits, (c) persona patience exceeded.

Needs (in addition to tn8.2):
- src/runner/flow-runner.ts: per-flow execution loop
- src/runner/step-judge.ts: AI evaluates whether success_criteria/give_up_criteria fired
- 'gauntlet run' wires to load flows from .gauntlet/flows/ and run them sequentially
- Per-step capture already exists; just call it after each action
close_reason: Stage 4 / Phase D shipped. Flow runner src/runner/flow-runner.ts drives a fresh Playwright context per (persona, flow) and runs each step through observe -> act -> capture -> judge. AI judges success/give_up against the captured page state and the persona voice. Patience threshold + observation_target fail-fast + give_up_criteria from the flow all enforce abandonment. Per-flow artifacts at runs/<ts>/<persona>/<flow>/{video, steps/NNNN/{screenshot, dom, ax-tree, axe, console, network}, flow-result.json}. 'gauntlet run' auto-detects curated flows and falls back to legacy single-step capture when none exist. Live verified: example.com -> iana.org navigation, 2 steps, both verdicts success, axe caught 3 real serious violations on iana.org. New: src/runner/{flow-runner,step-judge}.ts.

title: Stage 3: Phase C — AI flow proposal per persona + curation
description:
After persona roster is curated, for each persona ask the AI: 'given this persona's goals on this product, what 2-4 flows would they try?' A flow = ordered steps in natural language ('look for chicken recipes', 'open one', 'try to save it'). Curate per-persona just like Phase B. Output: .gauntlet/flows/<persona-id>.yaml.

Needs:
- src/flow/schema.ts (zod Flow / FlowStep)
- src/init/flow-generator.ts (AI call per persona)
- src/init/curate-flows.ts (interactive)
- CLI: 'gauntlet flows' command, also auto-runs at end of 'init'
- Loader for flows alongside persona loader
close_reason: Stage 3 / Phase C shipped: AI flow proposal per persona + interactive curation. New: src/flow/{schema,loader}.ts, src/init/{flow-generator,curate-flows}.ts, 'gauntlet flows' CLI command. Verified live against claude-opus-4-7: AI returned 3 flows for a curated marcus persona, voice + abandon conditions properly grounded in the persona, schema-valid.

title: Star-magnet polish: synergies from agentic-tool landscape scan
description:
From the 2026 landscape scan (browser-use, Stagehand, synthetic users, axe-core), five concrete adds to differentiate Gauntlet and pull stars:

1. axe-core every step (a11y baseline; unique 'persona + a11y' headline)
2. Stagehand-style act/observe/extract wrapper for the action loop
3. AI decision cache (persona_id, url_hash, step_idx, screen_hash) -> cheap reruns
4. WebVoyager-style benchmark + public leaderboard
5. Optional OCEAN personality field on character schema

Protect what nobody else has: vetting layer, edge personas, gated curation, free/self-hosted.

title: Stagehand-style action primitives wrapper (act/observe/extract)
description: Build src/agent/actions.ts exposing act(natural-language)/observe(natural-language)/extract(zod-schema) on top of Playwright. AI-resolved selectors. Used by the Phase D action loop instead of raw page.click().
close_reason: Stagehand-style act/observe/extract primitives shipped in src/agent/. Approach: build a numbered DOM outline of interactive elements (script eval'd in page); ask AI to pick idx + action; map back to a Playwright locator via getByRole/getByLabel/getByText. extract() introspects the zod schema and shows the AI the exact field-name shape. Verified live on example.com: observe matches 'main heading' to the H1, act clicked 'Learn more' and navigated to iana.org, extract filled all three required fields correctly.

title: AI decision cache keyed on (provider,model,messages,schema)
description: Cache propose() responses + resolved selectors. Disk cache in .gauntlet/cache/. Borrowed from Stagehand. Massive cost+speed on reruns.
close_reason: AiCache wraps every provider via CachingProvider decorator. Keys on sha256(provider+model+messages+schema+maxTokens+temperature). Disk-backed at .gauntlet/cache/ai/. Toggle via --no-cache. Validated cache hit re-parses through zod schema. Live test: 29.5s cold -> 0.5s warm (~60x), 24KB cache file.

title: WebVoyager-style benchmark + public leaderboard
description: 25-50 real landing pages, weekly via GitHub Action. README badge: 'Gauntlet found X bugs across top 100 SaaS landing pages.' Star magnet.
